archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) merged with soft touches of Archetype 3 for a premium, clean, modern AI SaaS feel

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all font-medium px-6 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.gradient: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 text-white hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all font-medium px-6 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all font-medium px-6 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2

cards.default: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 sm:p-8
cards.glass: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 rounded-2xl shadow-glass p-6 sm:p-8

inputs.default: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all text-slate-900

interactions.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) for cards, background color shifts for buttons
interactions.animation: Use framer-motion for page transitions, staggered list items, and smooth layout changes
interactions.loaders: Skeleton loaders matching rounded-2xl/rounded-xl shapes with a subtle pulse animation

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract subtle light illustration to be used at low opacity (10-20%) behind the glassmorphism hero for an AI vibe.
Bright, soft background to mix for gradient vibes.

logos.description: Use as a placeholder for integration cards if lucide icons are not sufficient.
Microsoft building image (can be used as a company banner/background in the CRM research panel).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global layout uses 'min-h-screen bg-slate-50 selection:bg-indigo-100 text-slate-900'.
Import Outfit font for headings and Inter for body text via Google Fonts in index.css.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons, sizing them appropriately (w-5 h-5 for inline, larger for empty states).
For the marketing page, use a glassmorphism sticky header: 'fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/50'.
The Dashboard must have a sidebar ('w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white') and a top navbar for search/profile.
Use realistic mock data for leads, emails, and CRM. Avoid generic 'Test 1', 'Test 2'. Use names like 'Acme Corp', 'Sarah Jenkins', etc.
Ensure all interactive elements have a data-testid attribute for testing (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button').
Include a functional Dark Mode toggle (using standard Tailwind 'dark:' variants). Ensure light theme is the absolute default and meticulously styled.
For the CRM Kanban, visually represent columns as rounded-2xl slate-50/100 containers with white rounded-xl cards inside.
For empty states, use a light grey icon and a gentle prompt text.
Implement the landing page hero with an animated workflow pipeline (using framer-motion to show Find Leads -> Research -> Email -> Call -> Book Meeting).

Build out all requested pages: Landing, Auth, Onboarding, Dashboard, Lead Discovery, Research, Email Studio, Phone Agent, Scheduler, CRM, Analytics, Automations, Knowledge Base, Integrations, Settings.
